h: Even a Holy Heart Needs Reminders and Protection

p: In Midrash Rabbah on this parsha
"Korach jumped up and said to Moshe:
A tallis that is entirely techeiles
from the meaning of the pasuk,
which has no allusion to it at all
except for its juxtaposition to the parsha of tzitzis?
that it is expounded from his claim
"For the entire congregation, all of them are holy,
and Hashem is in their midst."
since the main purpose of man
full of the fear of Hashem,
so that he can be a mighty one
and this is called the aspect of holiness,
for anyone who fences himself off
and also that the heart be
the illumination of words of Torah in his heart,
with all his attention on Him, Yisbarach,
the generation of the wilderness merited
at the time of Mattan Torah,
And the aspect of a kohen is known:
so that all his attention is
he is called by the aspect of kohen
(similar to what the Rambam, of blessed memory, wrote
סוֹף הִלְכוֹת שְׁמִיטָּה וְיוֹבֵל, יג, יג)
at the end of Hilchos Shemittah VeYovel, 13:13);
is the aspect of the utmost of yirah
in the soul, which is called holy,
from the mouth of whatever man who said them,
that the entire congregation, all of them are holy,
that is, that they were full
which is the aspect of holiness,
And also "Hashem is in their midst":
that is, that the innermost of their hearts
was full of the illumination of the Torah,
the reality of His providence, Yisbarach.
as is known from the holy Zohar
and this is alluded to in the pasuk,
"The entire congregation, all of them are holy."
is that the heart is full
of the illumination of the words of Torah,
and this is "Hashem is in their midst."
If so, "Why do you exalt yourselves?"
For it did not occur to them
that there was still some cause for concern for their souls,
that they were already complete in every respect.
However, Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
that even a tallis entirely of techeiles
one thread of techeiles in the tzitzis,
for even a soul full of yirah
can be befallen by the aspect of forgetting
if he does not set upon his heart
as they, of blessed memory, said
And even a house full of sefarim
as they, of blessed memory, said
and a mezuzah on his doorway
is assured that he will not sin";
which is the aspect of Kodesh Kodashim,
and fall short of the target of His will, Yisbarach.
And as is known from the holy sefarim
since in your own eyes you are distant
for this precisely you were chosen
on behalf of the souls of Klal Yisrael
to bring them back to holiness;
and this is the aspect of
And to this the Midrash Rabbah alludes
Rather, they sinned against their own souls";
if it should be made clear
then why do they need life
that is, he was a great sage
in the wisdom of the Torah,
and he should have known this,
שֶׁאָדָם אֵין צַדִּיק בָּאָרֶץ (קֹהֶלֶת ז, כ)
that "there is no man righteous on earth" (Koheles 7:20),
according to the inner chambers of Torah
and "saw a great chain of descendants, etc.";
and therefore it seemed to him
that he would be the chosen one.
וַיֵּרְדוּ הֵם חַיִּים שְׁאוֹלָה (בְּמִדְבַּר טז, לג)
"And they went down alive into the pit" (Bamidbar 16:33),
they are in the completeness of their vitality
And it is in the manner of
what is said of Adam HaRishon
and take also from the Tree of Life
and as is stated in Midrash Rabbah
that they are alive and existing
for in that very moment, immediately,
And in the time to come
they too are destined to rise,
He brings down to the pit and raises up."
